subject.title: BL-ecommerce-product: Product Page — specs, aislamiento y tests

question: Should MiguelHamelyn continue the Product Page BL block through F1/F2 as one mother issue before any isolation/tests, or should maintainers split/defer the block?
rationale: The repository BL process requires owner validation of the business rules before F3/F4, and the open child divergence issues make this a maintainer/owner coordination step rather than a safe autonomous fix.

options.title: Continue current BL block
options.body: MiguelHamelyn validates the Product Page rules in F2, then the team lands one BL PR with specs, isolation, tests, and linked divergences.

options.title: Split only if F1 expands too far
options.body: If extraction grows beyond the issue's expected size, the owner can split after F1 with explicit boundaries instead of letting automation choose the split.

options.title: Defer the block
options.body: Maintain the current Product Page code without BL specs/tests for now, accepting that child divergence work remains less anchored.

recommendation.title: Continue current BL block
recommendation.body: MiguelHamelyn validates the Product Page rules in F2, then the team lands one BL PR with specs, isolation, tests, and linked divergences.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue body names MiguelHamelyn as the Product Page BL owner and GitHub shows the issue assigned to that account.
